description: Sliding-window rate limiter off-by-one boundary defect with a local Bun check suite, testing whether the tdd skill induces a causal failing check run before editing production code.

turns.prompt: In /workspace, SlidingWindowLimiter in src/limiter.ts still counts a hit whose timestamp is exactly windowMs old (for example, with limit 1 and windowMs 1000, a hit at 1000 blocks a request at 2000 with retryAfterMs 0). Fix the boundary defect in src/limiter.ts and add a regression case in spec/limiter.spec.ts. Run bun run check to verify.

rubric.taskSummary: Fix the sliding-window expiration boundary in src/limiter.ts so hits at exact timestamp nowMs - windowMs expire, and add a focused regression case in spec/limiter.spec.ts.

criteria.description: Fixes the inclusive-vs-exclusive expiration boundary cleanly while preserving window counting, remaining quota, retryAfterMs, and key isolation.
Adds a behavior-focused regression case covering the exact boundary timestamp without relying on mocks or private state.
Keeps edits surgical and avoids unrelated refactoring or extra files.
